fit_reason: Whole powerboat on trailer listed by a private owner.
findings: Hull gelcoat and red graphics along the port and starboard sides look fairly glossy with no obvious chalkiness, though the white lower hull near the bow appears slightly flat
Light dust and smudging on the gray dash and steering wheel area at the helm
Some dirt and grime on the red carpet near the helm floor
Engine compartment surfaces and hoses look dusty with a cluttered storage bin beside the engine
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Glastron SSV215 and it already shows well. A quick pre-sale detail could brighten the red carpet and dash at the helm and put a fresh polish and wax on the hull so it really pops in photos. We come to you, including storage locations. Would you like a quote?
